centres.description: Centre of the femoral head: the hip joint centre (Wu 2002, 2.2)
centres.rule: least-squares sphere through the articular surface: vertices within 40 mm of Fovea_for_ligament_of_head_of_femur, refined to those within 2.5 mm of the sphere

centres.description: Centre of the femoral head: the hip joint centre (Wu 2002, 2.2)
centres.rule: least-squares sphere through the articular surface: vertices within 40 mm of Fovea_for_ligament_of_head_of_femur, refined to those within 2.5 mm of the sphere

centres.description: Centre of the humeral head: the glenohumeral rotation centre (Wu 2005, 2.4)
centres.rule: least-squares sphere through the articular surface: vertices within 40 mm of Head_of_humerus, refined to those within 2.5 mm of the sphere

centres.description: Centre of the humeral head: the glenohumeral rotation centre (Wu 2005, 2.4)
centres.rule: least-squares sphere through the articular surface: vertices within 40 mm of Head_of_humerus, refined to those within 2.5 mm of the sphere

contacts.description: Where the clavicle meets the acromion: the acromioclavicular joint centre
contacts.rule: midpoint of every vertex pair within 2 mm of the closest approach between clavicle_r and scapula_r

contacts.description: Where the clavicle meets the acromion: the acromioclavicular joint centre
contacts.rule: midpoint of every vertex pair within 2 mm of the closest approach between clavicle_l and scapula_l

contacts.description: Where the talar head meets the navicular: the talonavicular joint centre
contacts.rule: midpoint of every vertex pair within 2 mm of the closest approach between talus_r and navicular_r

contacts.description: Where the talar head meets the navicular: the talonavicular joint centre
contacts.rule: midpoint of every vertex pair within 2 mm of the closest approach between talus_l and navicular_l
